mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNLEADERSCHDUL ( SCHDUL_ID, SCHDUL_SE, SCHDUL_NM, SCHDUL_CN, SCHDUL_PLACE, LEADER_ID, REPTIT_SE_CODE, SCHDUL_BGNDE, SCHDUL_ENDDE, SCHDUL_CHARGER_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, CAL_ID ) VALUES ( #{schdulId}, #{schdulSe}, #{schdulNm}, #{schdulCn}, #{schdulPlace}, #{leaderId}, #{reptitSeCode}, #{schdulBgnde}, #{schdulEndde}, #{schdulChargerId}, #{frstRegisterId}, #{lastUpdusrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{calId} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHDUL_ID AS "schdul_id", s.SCHDUL_NM AS "title", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_BGNDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_BGNDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "start_dt", CASE WHEN s.SCHDUL_ENDDE IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE)) = 14 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(s.SCHDUL_ENDDE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE NULL END AS "end_dt", s.SCHDUL_PLACE AS "schdul_place", s.SCHDUL_CN AS "schdul_cn", s.CAL_ID AS "calId", c.COLOR AS "color" FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s JOIN CALENDAR c ON s.CAL_ID = c.CAL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR ( CAL_ID, CAL_NAME, COLOR, NOTE, ADD_DE, POST_DE, OWNER_ID ) VALUES ( #{calId}, #{calName}, #{color}, 'test', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{ownerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT trim(cal_id) cal_id, trim(cal_name) cal_name, trim(color) color, trim(owner_id) owner_id FROM CALENDAR ORDER BY cal_name

SELECT m.MTGRUM_ID, m.MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL s WHERE s.RESERVED_ROOM = m.MTGRUM_ID AND s.SCHDUL_BGNDE <= #{reserveDateTime} AND s.SCHDUL_ENDDE > #{reserveDateTime} ) ORDER BY m.MTGRUM_NM
SELECT TRIM(MTGRUM_ID) AS MTGRUM_ID, TRIM(MTGRUM_NM) AS MTGRUM_NM FROM COMTNMTGPLACEMANAGE ORDER BY MTGRUM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CALENDAR_SHARE ( SHARE_ID, AUTHORITY, CAL_ID, MBER_ID, SH_DE ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{authority}, #{calId}, #{mberId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNLEADERSCHDUL SET SCHDUL_NM = #{schdulNm}, SCHDUL_CN = #{schdulCn}, SCHDUL_PLACE = #{schdulPlace}, SCHDUL_BGNDE = #{schdulBgnde}, SCHDUL_ENDDE = #{schdulEndde}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) AS schdulId, TRIM(SCHDUL_NM) AS schdulNm, TRIM(SCHDUL_CN) AS schdulCn, TRIM(SCHDUL_PLACE) AS schdulPlace, TRIM(SCHDUL_BGNDE) AS schdulBgnde , TRIM(SCHDUL_ENDDE) AS schdulEndde, TRIM(CAL_ID) AS calId FROM COMTNLEADERSCHDUL WHERE TRIM(SCHDUL_ID) = TRIM(#{schdulId})
